edges.reason: block.timestamp controls the linear vesting formula, making the claimable amount miner-influenced.
claim() passes msg.sender into _claim as the vesting recipient.
msg.sender flows into _claim as the participant whose balance is paid out.
The onlyOwner guard on addRewards compares _msgSender() against the stored owner.
The _participant argument drives balance lookup, accounting updates and the token transfer.
balanceOf result is consumed by _claim as the payable amount.
balanceOf reads the Reward struct for the queried address from the rewards mapping.
_claim writes the updated paid amount back into the rewards mapping.
Token transfer to the participant is an external call executed inside _claim.
A malicious token can re-enter claim/_claim during the transfer callback.
Claimable balance is added to the participant's paid field with unchecked arithmetic.
Claimable balance is added to the global paidSoFar counter with unchecked arithmetic.
Local balance value flows into the unchecked paid increment.
Local balance value flows into the unchecked paidSoFar increment.
Constructor consumes the _owner argument to seed the Ownable ownership.
Constructor consumes the _token argument and stores it in umbToken.
Constructor assigns the deployed IERC20 token to the umbToken state variable.
balanceOf indexes the rewards mapping with the _address parameter.
balanceOf loads the reward struct into the local reward variable.
claimFor iterates over the _participants calldata array.
claimFor uses the local index i to walk the participant array.
claimFor invokes _claim once per participant element.
claim() delegates all work to the internal _claim function.
_claim receives the _participant argument and uses it for payout.
_claim stores the computed claimable value in the local balance variable.
addRewards reads the _participants array to index the rewards mapping.
addRewards reads reward totals from the _rewards array.
addRewards reads duration values from the _durations array.
addRewards reads start timestamps from the _startTimes array.
addRewards initializes the running sum local from totalVestingAmount.
addRewards reads the existing per-participant total into a local variable.
addRewards uses the local index i to iterate over all four arrays.
addRewards calls balanceOf to verify existing rewards are not reduced below already vested amounts.
addRewards reads totalVestingAmount as the base of the running sum.
addRewards writes the recomputed sum back into totalVestingAmount.
addRewards creates or overwrites Reward structs in the rewards mapping.
The onlyOwner modifier restricts addRewards to the stored _owner address.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner and rewrites the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership consumes the newOwner parameter after the zero-address check.
